summary: End-to-end testing of FlowDesk CRM (WhatsApp sales) completed. 17/17 backend pytest cases pass (auth, dashboard, contacts, leads CRUD with persistence verify, notes, conversations + send/handoff/status, REAL Claude Sonnet 4.6 AI summary + suggestion, tasks CRUD, admin RBAC including 403 for non-admin). Frontend UI flows manually exercised via Playwright with admin session cookie/Bearer token and all critical interactions work: dashboard metrics+charts render, Inbox 3-panel lists 8 conversations, send message works, bot/human handoff toggle flips, AI summary (660 chars) + suggested reply (188 chars) generated by real LLM, Use reply fills composer, Leads/Pipeline/Contacts/Tasks/Admin pages all load with expected demo data. No critical or blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Inbox.jsx is ~297 lines which is fine; consider splitting AI panel + composer + thread into sub-components if it grows beyond 400 lines.
AI endpoints call real LLM synchronously inside request handler. If multiple users invoke concurrently this can block; acceptable for MVP but consider streaming/background tasks at scale.
Bot handoff PATCH writes a bot_event log — verified working. Good auditability.
Auth supports both cookie and Bearer; PATCH /api/users correctly enforces admin-only via require_admin dependency (returns 403 for sales_agent, verified).
All entities use UUID `id` / `user_id` strings and Mongo `_id` is excluded in responses — clean.
updated_files: Seeded session_token records via mongosh: user_testadmin01 (admin) and user_testagent01 (sales_agent) for RBAC testing
test_credentials: Bearer test_session_admin_persist (admin@flowdesk.test, role=admin) and Bearer test_session_agent_persist (agent@flowdesk.test, role=sales_agent). Seeded into user_sessions/users collections.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 sessions: test_session_admin_persist for user_testadmin01 (admin) and test_session_agent_persist for user_testagent01 (sales_agent). Also created a few TEST_-prefixed contacts/leads/tasks during CRUD tests; leads/tasks self-cleaned via DELETE; TEST_Contact_X remains (no contact delete endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_flowdesk_api.py cover all 17 critical paths and can be re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_flowdesk_api.py -v. Session tokens are persistent (7 day expiry) so they should still work. If they expire, re-seed via mongosh per /app/auth_testing.md. Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://lead-scan-scheduler.preview.latusagent.com. All data-testid selectors documented in pages: nav-*, conv-item-*, bot-toggle, ai-summary-button, ai-suggest-button, use-suggestion-button, message-input, send-message-button, new-lead-button, lead-row-*, pipeline-card-*, pipeline-col-*, task-toggle-*, role-select-*, active-switch-*, etc.
rca of the issue: No issues found. One transient flake observed during initial sequence (Use reply did not fill composer after a prior send-message+toggle sequence), but isolated retest confirmed Use reply works correctly (suggestion text correctly written to Textarea). Root cause was test-timing: after send-message the conversation auto-refetched and React re-rendered, briefly clearing transient state; in isolation the click-to-fill works in <1.5s.
